theme.title: Theme
theme.subtitle: Switch between light and dark mode. Choice is remembered on this device.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Switch between English and বাংলা (Bangla). Affects all UI copy on this device.

anjali.title: Citizen reports
anjali.subtitle: Scope citizen reports to those filed from this date forward. Affects the reports you see on the dashboard. Persists on this device.

persona.title: Persona
persona.subtitle: The role you logged in with. To switch persona, log out and pick another from the sign-in screen.

reset.title: Reset demo
reset.subtitle: Clears the local chain, session, and theme/locale prefs, then reloads the page. Use this when you want to start fresh from the seeded fixtures.
reset.confirmBody: This clears the local chain, your session, and your theme/locale preferences, then reloads the page. You will be returned to the sign-in screen with seeded fixtures. This cannot be undone.
